name: scroll
css: * { box-sizing: border-box; } #s1, #s2, #s3, #o1 { width: 120px; } #s1 { height: 100px; overflow-y: auto; } #s2 { height: 80px; overflow-y: hidden; } #s3 { height: 90px; overflow: scroll; } #o1 { height: 100px; overflow-y: auto; } #n1 { width: 100px; height: 40px; overflow-y: auto; } #a1, #a2, #a3 { height: 50px; } #b1, #b2 { height: 50px; } #c1, #c2, #c3 { height: 40px; } #g1, #g2 { height: 30px; } #p1 { height: 90px; } #h1, #h2, #h3 { width: 110px; height: 40px; } #h1 { overflow-x: auto; } #h2 { overflow: hidden; } #h3 { overflow-x: scroll; overflow-y: hidden; } .hc { width: 45px; height: 30px; flex-shrink: 0; display: inline-block; }
